claims: ARGUS audits reported evidence for DiD identifying assumptions and explicitly does not adjudicate causal truth.
The synthetic flaw study shows a retrieval/abstention trade-off: its gated pipeline misses some omissions that ungated ablations flag.
In the small five-paper human-label pilot, weak retrieval produces excessive severity; the reported calibration adjustment is in-sample and untested on unseen papers.
source.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.

anchors.section: Human-label pilot, in-sample calibration and discussion

adverse_findings_and_limits: Failure to retrieve evidence is different from absence of evidence in the paper.
Synthetic flaw injection, a general-economics corpus and a small reconciled pilot do not establish climate-policy or bank validation.
High agreement with majority medium labels can mask poor discrimination; author-reported improvements are not external review.
source.project_disposition: Candidate evidence-audit pattern with retrieval status distinct from scientific risk, and expert adjudication retained.

claims: oci-agent places an accountable human principal over actor/critic personas and reproducible notebooks using deterministic causal libraries.
It targets point-in-time effects under supplied unconfoundedness, with cross-fitted AIPW and design diagnostics.
Authors report 231 ACIC datasets, a ten-dataset scaffolding comparison, and disguised LaLonde evaluations; the critic declines most PSID replications for poor overlap.

anchors.section: Sections 2–5: point-in-time targets and principal/actor/critic workflow
Section 5.2: ACIC evaluation and scaffolding ablation
Section 5.2.4: disguised LaLonde and critic refusal

adverse_findings_and_limits: The Netflix deployment and benchmark outcomes are author-reported, not independently reproduced here.

Trimming by a propensity interval changes the target to a trimmed-population effect; the text calls it ATO, but overlap-weighted ATO uses a different weighting measure. Inspect the code before mapping that target.
Balance and overlap diagnostics cannot certify absence of unmeasured confounding. Selected critic-approved estimates do not automatically have conditional coverage.
Point-in-time estimation is not longitudinal policy identification; sequential positivity, treatment-confounder feedback and dependent sampling remain separate requirements.
source.project_disposition: Candidate audited notebook/critic architecture, with explicit target-change approval and transparent refusal denominators.

claims: The paper describes causal-learn+ with agent assistance for data inspection, assumption elicitation, method selection and interpretation around formal discovery algorithms.
It distinguishes agent suggestions, user decisions, algorithm parameters and graph outputs, and explains why CPDAG/PAG ambiguity must remain visible.
It calls for future benchmarks of data diagnosis, method selection and calibrated interpretation.
adverse_findings_and_limits: This is a design argument and system description, not an independently qualified bank workflow or measured institutional benefit.
User approval does not prove assumption truth, and formal algorithms remain conditional on their sampling and scientific premises.
A declared, separately validated hybrid method is conceptually possible; the paper’s restrictive design preference is not a universal impossibility theorem.
source.project_disposition: Use the scoped argument with attached limits; package execution and empirical qualification remain separate.

source.title: Large Language Models as Co-Pilots for Causal Inference in Medical Studies
source.local_path: docs/papers/Large Language Models as Co-Pilots for Causal Inference in Medical Studies Alaa(2024).pdf
source.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: The proposed co-pilot follows a causal roadmap from the scientific question to assumptions, statistical estimands and interpretation.
Examples distinguish prevalent from incident users and specify eligibility, follow-up, baseline time, treatment and outcome; the paper discusses potentially time-varying exposure.
The authors find that careful cues help illustrative answers while off-the-shelf zero-shot responses may remain generic and miss relevant biases.
source.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.
adverse_findings_and_limits: This is a proposal with illustrative prompts, not a qualified longitudinal-policy implementation.
The paper itself identifies contamination uncertainty and missing study-design evaluations; medical-knowledge tests cannot substitute for study-design validity.
Transfer of these study-design principles to banking is a project proposal and needs owner-approved clocks and decisions.
source.project_disposition: Use as primary motivation for a typed business-to-target review; retain longitudinal execution as an explicit evidence gap.

claims: Orchestrates specifications, notebook execution and actor/critic outputs; the README explicitly calls it a reference research implementation.
NotebookClient executes a spec-selected notebook with timeout=-1 in its parent directory.
README and pyproject NumPy requirements disagree; use actual pinned environment, not an assumed working installation.
The pinned notebook labels a uniformly averaged AIPW pseudo-outcome on a propensity-trimmed subset as ATO; this is not the conventional e(X)(1-e(X))-weighted overlap estimand.
adverse_findings_and_limits: Prefer adapting audited notebook/result ideas behind fixed verified operations. Do not expose its general notebook runner through our bounded MCP surface.
Obtain registered benchmark data explicitly; an ACIC-shaped synthetic generator is not the original ACIC release.
Trimming/ATO mapping remains under notebook review.
Rename the target to trimmed-population ATE with threshold and selection rule, or implement and qualify actual overlap weighting. Estimated trimming adds target/selection uncertainty.
